rationale: Stable v1.82.0 already has Plan wall/opening editing, device placement/history and one-cell Decor keyboard nudging. Extend precise keyboard translation to those existing Plan/Devices workflows through their existing physical and CAS writers, without a new model, endpoint or editing subsystem.

summary.ru: Сдвиг свободной стены, проёма и устройства стрелками на клетку с сохранением смещения и отдельной отменой каждого шага.
summary.en: Move free walls, openings and devices one grid cell with arrow keys, preserving their offset and individual Undo steps.
